name: 乐曹植

skills.name: 赋乐
skills.text: 锁定技，你的初始手牌增加“赋”标记且不计入手牌上限。“赋”随机获得另一种非装备牌牌名，使用“赋”时可选择使用该牌所拥有的任意一种牌名。

skills.name: 文澜
skills.text: 你每使用或打出两张牌结算后：若为包含相同牌名的两张“赋“，你从牌堆中获得这两张“赋”所含牌名的牌各一张，并标记为“赋”；否则你选择任意张手牌标记为“赋”或替换“赋”牌名。

currentVersusFormal: Fresh current hero all four skins use exactly the same two complete texts. Formal launch gives the same complete wording. No verified later first-party rebalance/FAQ found in bounded exact-name/skill-name searches; third-party test-server wording is not authoritative.

userDecisions.decision: 按使用/打出顺序固定配对，第 2 张结算完成后触发

userDecisions.topic: 赋乐随机非装备牌名池
userDecisions.decision: 当前模式允许的非装备牌名，含延时锦囊，火杀/雷杀单列；排除原印刷名，且不随牌堆耗尽缩小

engineeringInterpretations: Wenlan has no turn-reset clause: its accepted true Use or Played sequence persists across turns and source loss. A true response Use appearing in both native completion windows counts once.
The shared-name branch requires two Fu entities with intersecting frozen name sets and obtains one actual DrawPile entity per distinct name in their union. An absent name produces no synthetic card.
Fule permits choosing a name for true Uses, including native response Uses. It grants no extra alias for a pure Played response.

Each real action counts once. A Fu action requires exactly one actual marked physical material; zero-material and multi-material actions still count toward the pair but have no single Fu identity. A single marked material retains its physical printed-plus-alias name set through another native conversion. This is an engineering interpretation, not a claimed official FAQ.

Fu is a permanent physical entity mark with one printed name and one random alternate name. Its hand-limit exemption requires the current holder to have active Fule. Replacing an alias excludes both the printed name and the old alias so replacement actually changes the name.

The name pool comes from the selected immutable ContentDeckRecipe and the same deterministic native mode face mappings used for the initial deck. It retains Wenhe suit-dependent names and actual mode removals. Hulao random equipment selection is not rerun. Querying this pool consumes no random numbers or gameplay state.

A newly obtained ordinary entity receives its first Fu alias before gain observers. Obtaining an entity already marked Fu preserves its alias and revision; only the explicit private Hand-rewrite branch rerolls an existing alias. An empty alternate pool retains a printed-only mark or the previous alias without manufacturing a name.

Logical action snapshots freeze the single physical Fu name set before material movement. Native true response Uses and pure Played follow their original actor/provider and payment contracts. Source loss does not reclassify already accepted entries.

Forced alias Slash availability requires the exact current native Borrowed Sword or Qinglong parent frontier. An ancestor forced-Use request does not authorize an alias Slash for an intervening pure Played Duel response.

Legacy direct virtual Duels use their own source-bound typed acceptance, completion and return receipt. They participate in the same accepted pair sequence without inventing CardUseDeclared or CardActionAccepted facts for a producer that never issued those native facts.

An exact native actor-replacement chain moves an unconsumed pending Use from the old actor tail to the new actor active-source sequence while retaining the original physical Fu names and provider. Previously claimed pairs remain frozen; a later replacement does not roll back an already resolved benefit.
verificationLimits: No authenticated official gameplay client or character-specific official FAQ established the engineering interpretations above.
